name: hunarbazaar
description: HunarBazaar is a platform that connects skilled local workers—such as carpenters, masons, electricians, halwais, and more—with people who need their services. It functions like a freelancing marketplace but specifically caters to small-scale workers, helping them gain online visibility and secure jobs easily. The platform bridges the gap between skilled professionals and customers, offering an easy-to-use interface and seamless hiring process. By leveraging technology, HunarBazaar aims to modernize the local service sector and provide better income opportunities for workers.
